section_summary.extract_value: This is a discussion section of an experimental study examining the relationship between guilt, appearance goals for exercise, and body anxiety in women. The study found that guilt fully mediated the effect of a guilt manipulation on body anxiety, and this guilt effect was specific to exercise-related guilt rather than general negative emotions. The authors acknowledge important methodological limitations, including the cross-sectional nature of the mediation analysis (both mediator and outcome measured at post-test) and the lack of pre-test guilt measurement, which limit causal inferences about the guilt manipulation's influence on body anxiety.
